column2: A one-time boon is a single-use triggered ability with no source
column3: the only card is unsupported: boons are a digital-only mechanic (docs/DEFERRED.md, digital-only cards); the paper printing is legal only in Arena formats

column3: deferred: the ruling is about an infinite X, i.e. infinite mana, which only Urza's Fun House ({T}: Add {∞}) can make, an acorn card not legal in any format (docs/DEFERRED.md, cards not legal in any format), in an Un- game; the CR's numbers are integers (CR 107.1) and the engine has no infinite ones

column2: You do get to choose which lands get tapped.
column3: the engine lacks the behavior: a spell's mana cost is paid by the automatic payment planner (mana_abilities.rs, pay_mana), with no decision about which sources to tap or which of a land's mana abilities to use; a player chooses only by activating mana abilities while they have priority, and a card played during Word of Command's resolution is played with no priority, so its controller can't pick the lands or a tap-and-sacrifice mana ability (rulings-P115, 2026-11-19)
